narrative: AI developments include NVIDIA's new tools for world models and a new feature from 1Password allowing AI agents to use passwords securely. In technology, Apple is introducing a new badge for apps optimized for its foldable iPhone Duo, while the Atari VCS software store is shutting down next year. Cybersecurity is also a major concern, with multiple PHP vulnerabilities and compromised certificates being reported.
